The example uses vi sóng as the appliance name rather than demonstrating its radiation meaning.
flags.fix: Lò này dùng vi sóng để làm nóng thức ăn. = This oven uses microwaves to heat food.

flags.why: An nhàn is ordinary contemporary vocabulary usable in casual conversation, so literary unnecessarily restricts its use.
Phạm trù belongs to formal or academic usage rather than serving as an everyday neutral word for category.
The common collective meaning referring to troops or military forces is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/bộ_đội)).
